text:
sara: FYI seeing intermittent packet loss between GPU pods on us-west-2 during nightly training backfills, ~1-3% p50->p50 RTT spikes and retransmits. starts ~01:10 UTC and lasts a few mins.
ashok: which overlay? vxlan or geneve? any node-level RX/TX drops?
sara: vxlan on top of mlx5 hosts. no obvious link errors. dmesg clean. some NIC counters show TSO/GRO drops.
kevin: can you paste the tc / ip -s link counters from one affected node?
sara: pasted snippet:

```
$ ip -s link show dev vxlan0
RX: bytes 1234567 packets 12345 errors 0 dropped 12
TX: bytes 2345678 packets 23456 errors 0 dropped 0
```

ashok: dropped=12 on RX looks like kernel-side reassembly drops (GRO) rather than hw errors.
nicola: any recent kernel or mlx driver rollouts in the pool? I recall a kernel bump last week.
sara: kernel 6.1.21 on these nodes, rolled 3 days ago. driver mlx5 5.16.1. rollback candidate noted.
kevin: earliest repro? do we have tcpdump/katran traces? can we run `tcpdump -i vxlan0 -vvv 'icmp or tcp'` on canary pod pair?
sara: started tcpdump on pod pair and grabbed an example where we see repeated dup ack + fast retransmit and some packets with bad checksum offload flag.
ops-bot: canary probe created: infra/canaries/vxlan-eastwest-loss-2026-03-20, scheduled 02:00 UTC.
ashok: try disabling RX/TX offloads on the host for vxlan interface as a quick mitigation: `ethtool -K eth0 tx off rx off gso off gro off tso off`
kevin: note that disabling offload will increase CPU, but for canary it's fine.
sara: ran offload disable on one canary node — retransmits dropped to 0.5% for the window and training job recovered tail latency. rolling to 5 nodes for next hour.
nicola: let's also check PMTU/encap path MTU: maybe fragmenting inside overlay with GSO -> kernel bug. run `ip route get` and `ss -i` on affected sockets.
ashok: good call. Also capture `ethtool -S eth0` around the spike to see GSO/GRO counters.
kevin: assign action: 1) reproduce with offload=on vs off on a small fleet and collect tcpdump+ethtool+tracepoints. 2) open vendor case with Mellanox/NVIDIA with logs and exact kernel/driver. 3) prepare rollback to previous kernel for emergency.
sara: I'll collect repro artifacts and upload to the canary ticket. starting automated repro loop now (`iperf3 -u` and `wrk` for tcp). ETA 40m.
ops-bot: incident ticket INF-4621 created and linked to canary.
nicola: add runbook note: if offload disable improves P50 but CPU > 65% revert and use hostNetwork for critical workloads until driver fix.
ashok: one more experiment: try switching overlay encapsulation from vxlan to geneve on a canary sandbox, driver paths differ and might avoid the bug.
kevin: agreed. keep the scope small. escalate to oncall if more than 5% loss or >2 customer-impacting jobs fail.
sara: update: after 30m with offload disabled on 5 nodes, no spikes. uploading tcpdump and ethtool logs to INF-4621.
ashok: thanks — will start vendor case template now. tagging @mellanox in the ticket.
kevin: good triage. we'll schedule kernel rollback window if vendor case not progressing in 24h.
ops-bot: reminder: change scheduled for rollback window requires RFC and Slack notice 2 hours prior. :bell:
sara: noted. will update thread with artifacts and next steps. :thumbsup:
